summary: Product-wide shared ellipsis action-menu visibility repair. Owner screenshots showed icon-only or apparently blank rows across Navigation, Topics and Watch, indicating a shared defect rather than one page. The shared terminal stylesheet loader now preserves the asset.php endpoint and current version query instead of resolving /interaction-polish.css incorrectly. A terminal reset loaded after page-specific CSS forces overflow controls to full-width visible text menu items. Source inventory covers the nine primary surfaces: Home has no per-resource ellipsis; Navigation, Channels, Watch, Topics, Courses, Tools and Software use the shared overflow path; Projects already uses an independent real-text menu. No Navigation/Shared Shell geometry, frozen page redesign, data model, schema, migration, auth/security, provider, or updater mechanism change. Production remains Owner manual.
